rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=2, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-10, ONE-KNOB change vs the iter-8 PEAK base (SSIM 0.9747, PSNR 38.63 dB; proj_n_bf=1, proj_sr=0.0005, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, n_iter=300). KNOB: projection-domain bilateral cascade DEPTH proj_n_bf 1 -> 2 (adds a 2nd projection-domain TrainableBilateralFilter2d; 12 -> 18 trainable BF params). EVERYTHING else identical to iter-8 (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005; proj_sx/proj_sy/proj_kernel left at Wagner-abdomen defaults; proj_sr applied to BOTH proj BFs via solver init). TRAJECTORY: iter-1 0.9720/38.17; iter-2 (all 3 proj sigmas at once off loose base) 0.9680 HURT; iter-3 (img_sr tight) 0.9723; iter-4 (img_n_bf 1->3) 0.9732 PEAK; iter-5 (img_n_bf 3->5) 0.9729 SAT; iter-6 (img_kernel 7->9) 0.9731 FLAT; iter-7 (n_iter 300->600) 0.9732 FLAT; iter-8 (proj_sr 0.02->0.0005 ISOLATED) 0.9747/38.63 NEW PEAK +0.0015; iter-9 (proj_sr 0.0005->0.0001) 0.97475 FLAT (delta < 3e-6 vs iter-8) -- the projection-RANGE lever is SATURATED at proj_sr=0.0005. FAILURE MODE at 0.9747: all four IMAGE-domain axes (depth/range/kernel/n_iter) exhausted at iter-4-7; the projection-RANGE sigma lever broke the ceiling at iter-8 but saturated at iter-9. The one UNTESTED projection-domain axis at the peak base is the projection cascade DEPTH proj_n_bf -- the RESERVED structural lever, now justified because the tight-range projection regime (proj_sr=0.0005) is established and a 2nd edge-preserving projection BF can stack additional sinogram denoising on the same tight-range basis instead of compounding a Gaussian blur. WHY proj_n_bf NOW: img_n_bf cascade depth was the active IMAGE-domain lever once img_sr was tight (iter-4 1->3 PEAK); by symmetry, now that proj_sr is tight a 2nd projection BF should add multi-scale edge-preserving sinogram denoising. The projection-range sigma is saturated (iter-9 flat), so the next move on the projection domain is structural depth, not a tighter sigma. HYPOTHESIS: does a 2nd projection BF stage (proj_n_bf 1->2) at tight proj_sr=0.0005 lift SSIM past iter-8 0.9747, or does the projection cascade saturate like img_n_bf saturated past 3? If SSIM > 0.9747 the projection cascade has depth headroom; if FLAT (within +-0.0005 of 0.9747) the projection domain is exhausted across BOTH range and depth, confirming the ~0.9747 12-18-param structural ceiling -- the BF inductive bias approaches but cannot beat a clean 128-view FBP. WALL: a 2nd projection BF adds one sinogram-domain BF pass per step (small vs the FBP-adjoint-dominated per-step cost); step budget IDENTICAL to iter-8 (n_iter=300, val_n=16; warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 16x300=4800); iter-8 ran 457 s, far under the 1800 s sbatch wall; outer_wall_s=1500 internal guard unchanged.
